title: Clinical Voice AI Speech Recognition Vulnerability & Safety Audit

findings.transliteration_drift: Off-the-shelf Whisper models output phonetic Romanization (Banglish) rather than standardized Bengali Unicode script, resulting in high unicode CER/WER.
findings.numeric_formatting_risk: Numbers in Bengali medical dictation (e.g. '১২০ বাই ৮০' vs '120/80') risk being dropped, misinterpreted, or phonetically garbled without specialized medical ASR tokenization.
findings.clinical_safety_protocol: Unassisted voice dictation MUST NOT commit directly to Electronic Health Records (EHR) without physician review and verified multi-pass post-editing.
